text:
maria: Quick sync — proposing launch acceptance criteria for the on-prem VPC packaging. TL;DR: need clear gating on networking, upgrade path, and field buy-in. Draft below, pls comment by EOD.
- must support customer-managed IPAM/peering (BGP/Static) with documented handshake
- zero-config fallback for simple installs (single-host) with auto NAT
- upgrade path: in-place patch upgrades with <5m per node median downtime; clear rollback
- installer: airgap bundle + signed checksums + optional offline CA trust
- SLAs: target P99 latency degrade policy + support RTO/RPO for reserved customers
- migration: tooling to export/import tenant config, secrets handled via KMS/HSM
Example agent config snippet:
```
handshake:
  mode: customer-owned
  fallback: carrier-nat
```
sam: For the <5m per-node downtime target — what's the rollback window? customers asked for 30m maintenance window guarantees.
maria: Good call. We should define 2 tracks: GA (best-effort) and Enterprise SLA (contracted 30m window for minor upgrades). GA doc will list recommended maintenance window 1h.
raj: We need to add a compatibility matrix for plugins/sidecars. Field reported that some datastores require kernel tuning; want note in launch doc.
jen: Field note — several customers asked for explicit IP preservation on upgrade. Also want NAT traversal guide and a simple checklist for netops handoff.
maria: ok adding: "preserve cluster network identity" and "preflight checks: IP persistence, IPAM reachability, DNS propagation test". Anyone object to making IP preservation a hard blocker for Enterprise SLA?
sam: No objection. But we should add fallback: automated drain+reassign if IP not available — to avoid bricking.
raj: On packaging variants — lightweight single-container distro vs full operator: recommend we ship both but mark single-container as "support-limited".
jen: Also request pricing note: standard hosting fee vs dedicated onprem license + optional support hours. Field expects a 1yr commit discount.
maria: We'll surface pricing later; for roadmap gating I want: customers committed (>=2 POCs with netops signoff) OR internal signoff from solutions+sales. Add "POC signoff template" as deliverable.
deploy-bot: pipeline: onprem-installer-v1 build succeeded (artifact 2026-03-21T15:02Z), smoke tests failed on DNS edge-case — tracking ticket #INT-4389
maria: thanks. Action items:
- raj: produce compatibility matrix draft by Wed
- sam: define rollback/maintenance SLA text and fallback behavior by Thu
- jen: collect 3 field POC signoffs + pricing expectations
- maria: write launch acceptance doc and checklist
all: please react :thumbsup: if you can meet these dates
